text:
DeployBot: [deploy] Release v3.9.1 -> prod starting. Canary: 5% traffic to new runtime. Observability: embeddings-service p95 increased ~40% vs baseline. Autorevert: OFF (manual hold). Please ack and advise rollback vs hold.
Amal: ack. seeing the same in dashboards, reproduces on canary host.
Kyle: on it — can you confirm it's embeddings-specific? any errors in logs?
Amal: looks route-scoped. text-generation p95 stable, embeddings p95 +40% and 502 spikes ~0.2% on canary. logs show a KV cache miss surge.
SreLee: tagging in. If KV miss is root, a full rollback might be heavy — can we target the embeddings route (traffic-slice) back to v3.9.0?
OpsLead: who has authority to pin traffic for this release? I can run the traffic-slice command but want confirmation.
Maria: ops decision ok with me, but need comms: release notes freeze + customer advisory if rollback affects dedicated customers.
ProductCW: agreed on comms. If we do a targeted rollback for embeddings only, add a line in release notes: "embeddings routed to stable runtime due to performance regression in canary" and notify impacted enterprise seats.
Kyle: ready to execute. plan: 1) pin embeddings route to v3.9.0 (traffic-slice override), 2) monitor p95 and error rate for 15m, 3) if stable, cut release note and close. rollback cmd (ops):
```
# pin embeddings route
redwoodctl route set --route embeddings --version v3.9.0 --reason "canary p95 regression"
```
Amal: also prepare revert PR to revert the embedding runtime change (ref: repo@commit abc1234) so we have a clean history.
SreLee: will watch telemetry and have alert on slack if p95 > 1.2x baseline.
DeployBot: NOTE: traffic-slice action requires human confirmation. Scheduled cutoff for rollback actions in change window: 3472000100.
OpsLead: executing pin now.
OpsLead: /run redwoodctl route set --route embeddings --version v3.9.0 --reason "manual-pin-canary-regression"
DeployBot: action accepted: embeddings route pinned to v3.9.0 by OpsLead at 3472000027. Canary traffic for new runtime reduced to 0% for embeddings.
Kyle: monitoring telemetry — p95 back to baseline within 2 minutes. errors down. :thumbsup:
Maria: drafting customer note: "We temporarily routed embeddings traffic to the previously stable runtime due to a performance regression detected during canary. No data loss. Working on fix; will update." Who should we send to customers? list of seats?
ProductCW: send to Enterprise BG + customers with high embeddings QPS (via sales). I’ll draft and share in #customer-success.
Amal: created revert PR #452 and linked the incident.
SreLee: keeping alerts on for 30m. If anything re-escalates we'll consider a full rollback.
Kyle: ops, can you add a release-note blurb now so the release page shows the pin?
OpsLead: added note to release metadata: "embeddings route pinned to v3.9.0 due to canary latency regression (investigating)."
Maria: Customer note queued. ProductCW will review.
ProductCW: reviewed + approved. Maria please send.
Amal: next steps: debug KV cache change in staging, run perf tests, validate fix then we can redeploy a patched v3.9.1.
OpsLead: closing action in this thread. If telemetry stays stable for 30m, we'll mark this incident resolved and re-open release window for patched rollout.
SreLee: resolved flag in monitoring if no regressions after 30m.
Kyle: thanks everyone.
Maria: sent customer advisory to the list.
DeployBot: Incident note: embeddings pin executed. Logs and events archived under incident/INC-2026-045.
Amal: ack, filing postmortem draft.
OpsLead: +1. moving to postmortem channel for writeup. Cheers.
